title: Skill Frontmatter
description: Formalizes the YAML frontmatter block of every skills/<name>/SKILL.md file, per CLAUDE.md's Component Frontmatter table. Validates SHAPE only — the required, ordered field set (name, description, version, phase, owner, created, tags) plus their formats. additionalProperties is true because frontmatter may carry forward-compatible fields (related, produces, domain, status, and others introduced by later campaign phases) that this base schema deliberately does not close off.

name.description: The skill's directory name and canonical identifier. Matches the plugin-wide component naming convention (lowercase, hyphen-separated) from CLAUDE.md's Naming Conventions table.

description.description: The literal discovery/matching surface a skill fires on — not a human-facing summary. Per skill-authoring-standards, this is the trigger text Claude Code matches prompts against.

version.description: Semantic version (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH). Bumps follow the two-surface rule in skill-authoring-standards: a description change that alters what matches is MAJOR; body content without trigger change is MINOR; wording fixes are PATCH.

phase.description: The SDLC phase this skill's expertise applies to (Strategy, Ideate, Design, Implement, Data, Quality, Deploy, Customer Validation) — or a cross-cutting label. A free-form string; not enumerated here.

owner.description: The role or agent accountable for this skill's content.

created.description: ISO-8601 date the skill was created.

tags.description: A non-empty list of lowercase-hyphen classification tags (e.g. logical skill_domains membership).

related.description: Optional. Other skill names this skill's body references in prose. Not part of the required, ordered schema; retrofit as-you-go per skill-authoring-standards.

produces.description: Optional. The artifact(s) applying this skill yields — a single artifact name or a list of them.

domain.description: Optional. The logical skill_domains grouping this skill belongs to (a tag, never a filesystem path).

status.description: Optional. Maturity of the skill's content.
